newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux in 2.5 bln skr restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux in 2.5 bln skr restructuring.

text.p: Swedish appliance maker AB Electrolux said on Thursday it was implementing a two-year restructuring program that will include closing about 25 plants and cutting 12,000 staff.
Electrolux said in a statement it saw restructuring costs of about 2.5 billion crowns ($321.6 million) which will be charged completely against operating income in the second quarter of 1997.
It said these costs would be partly offset by a capital gain of about 600 million crowns from the divestment of Husqvarana Sewing Machines in the second quarter.

"In order to achieve the group's long-term financial goals, ie an operating margin of 6.5-7.0 percent, and a return of equity of 15 percent, the board of directors of AB Electrolux has authorised a restructuring programme," Electrolux said.
Electrolux said it currently employed about 105,000 people and had about 150 plants.
Electrolux was to hold a press conference in Stockholm at 1400 GMT on Thursday.
